Permohonan disemak, dinilai Jabatan Teknikal (charting + laporan tanah), disediakan Kertas Pertimbangan, dan diputuskan oleh Pentadbir Tanah (KPPD/PTNH) — bukan mesyuarat jawatankuasa formal. Jika lulus, hakmilik MCL (Sementara/HSBM atau Kekal/HKBM-HKGHS) didaftarkan; jika tolak, Surat Tolak dikeluarkan.

urusans.notes: Grepped case-insensitively for TANGGUH, JKKL, JKKT across the whole file: zero matches — confirms the MCL BPMN has no committee-style JKKL/JKKT decision and no deferral (Tangguh) outcome anywhere. The only outcome-determining fork is exclusiveGateway "Kelulusan" (sid-3E5D7514), fed by a boolean ${keputusan} variable set after "16.0/17.0 Keputusan Pentadbir Tanah (KPPD/PTNH)" — i.e. a single officer's (Pentadbir Tanah) decision, not a jawatankuasa sitting. A separate, earlier gateway "Keputusan Awal" (sid-261C69FE, var ${keputusanAwal}) exists right after "9.0 Perakuan Jabatan Teknikal..." and can also route straight to a reject path ("43.0 Penyediaan Minit Bebas" -> ... -> converges into the same "46.0 Penyediaan Surat Tolak" task) without ever reaching Kertas Pertimbangan — this is a preliminary/administrative screening reject, not the main committee-analog decision, so it is omitted from stages[] to keep the linear happy path to one decision point per the task instructions. The BPMN starts with a technical userTask "DELAY (35 s)" before "3.0 Semakan Kemasukan Maklumat" — a wait-state artifact, not a BA-visible stage, omitted from stages[]. No task numbered 1.0/2.0 exists in this file, consistent with MCL intake originating from the AWAM/e-Mohon portal (outside this internal Flowable process) before "3.0 Semakan Kemasukan Maklumat" runs. Table umm_a_pelupusan (used in the PT analog for committee-prep) and dft_a_hkmlk (used in the PT analog for title issuance) do NOT exist in schema_parse.json — substituted with plp_a_pelupusan and dft_a_mohon_hkmlk respectively, both verified present.
